title: 18 U.S.C. § 3624(g)(1) — who is eligible
status: historical trial design, not approval or source evidence

cue.heading: 18 U.S.C. § 3624(g)(1) — who is eligible
cue.text: … a prisoner … who— (A) <mark>has earned time credits</mark> … in an amount that is equal to the remainder of the prisoner’s imposed term of imprisonment; (B) … has maintained a minimum or low recidivism risk …; (C) has had the remainder of the prisoner’s imposed term of imprisonment computed …; and (D) … has been determined under the System to be a minimum or low risk to recidivate … or … has had a petition to be transferred to prerelease custody or supervised release approved by the warden …
